Fievel

Privacy policy

Effective 21 October 2026

Fievel is an open source plugin and repository that helps you build a content system with your coding agent. This policy covers the Fievel plugin for Claude Code and Codex, the Fievel repository and this website.

What Fievel collects

Nothing. Fievel has no accounts, servers, analytics, telemetry or advertising. Its Python tools and generated pages run on your computer and make no network requests. We never receive your project files, prompts or conversations.

Where your files are stored

Your content system is saved as files in the folder you choose. Fievel does not save projects inside the installed plugin and does not copy them anywhere else. Pages Fievel generates, such as the system viewer and review forms, embed your project data. Anyone you share those files with can read that data.

Your coding agent

Fievel runs inside a coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot. Anything you or Fievel read into the conversation, including your source documents, is processed by that agent's provider under its own terms and privacy policy. Only bring sources you are authorized to use.

Installing dependencies

Fievel needs Python and the jsonschema package. If you approve it, Fievel installs jsonschema from the Python Package Index into a folder in your workspace. That download is between your computer and the Python Package Index.

This website

This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. It sets no cookies and loads no analytics or third party scripts. GitHub may log technical information, such as IP addresses, as described in the GitHub Privacy Statement.

Changes and contact

We will post any changes on this page with a new effective date. For questions, open an issue at github.com/jeremydhoover-blip/fievel-content-system/issues.
